critical_code_review_comments: VideoEmbed.jsx (lines ~155-185): playerVars correctly omits mute and autoplay — confirmed against live iframe src on /feed. The IntersectionObserver mounts iframe once and pauses on scroll-away. Spec-compliant.

communities.py founder_add_member / founder_remove_member: username==='stealth' gate enforced server-side. Add is idempotent (already_member:true). Owner-removal blocked (400). Support admin correctly receives 403.
Messages.jsx ChevronRight handler: stopPropagation works — clicking the arrow navigates without firing the row's chat handler (dialogs=0 after arrow click). Touch target = 44x44 as required.

Realms.jsx + RealmDetail.jsx: resolveMediaUrl() produces identical absolute URLs on both grid card and detail banner for the same realm (gaming verified). onError graceful hide is present in the code path (not exercised here since all 8 seeded banners loaded successfully).
